name: Domäne des Lebens
description: Positive Energie, die heilt und erhält.

1.name: Domänenzauber
1.description: Immer vorbereitet: u. a. Segnen, Wunden heilen, Wiederbeleben.

2.name: Göttliche Macht: Leben bewahren
2.description: Heilung von 5 × Stufe auf Kreaturen in 30 ft verteilen.

6.name: Gesegneter Heiler
6.description: Heilst du andere, heilst du dich um 2 + Zaubergrad.

8.name: Göttlicher Schlag
8.description: Einmal pro Zug +1W8 gleißender Schaden mit Waffen (Stufe 14: 2W8).

en.name: Life Domain
en.description: Positive energy that heals and sustains.

1.name: Disciple of Life
1.description: Healing spells restore an extra 2 + spell level.

1.name: Domain Spells
1.description: Always prepared: e.g. bless, cure wounds, revivify.

2.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
2.description: Distribute 5 × level healing among creatures within 30 ft.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: Healing others also heals you for 2 + spell level.

8.name: Divine Strike
8.description: Once per turn +1d8 radiant weapon damage (2d8 at level 14).

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: Healing dice always count as their maximum.
